record_type_quote:
The analysis consisted of two-level models with individuals nested in countries, using data from
the European Social Survey Round 5.

targets.title: The Cultural Divide in Europe: Migration, Multiculturalism, and Political Trust
targets.evidence_quote:
The claim selected for replication from McLaren (2012) is that individuals expressing most
concern about the impact of immigration on the national community will be most distrusting of
politicians and political institutions (Proposition 1).
targets.outcome_quote:
All analyses – the main analysis and the auxiliary analyses – indicate that concern about
immigration is positively association with distrust in the country’s parliament, i.e. confirm the
result in the replicated study, so the replication was successful according to SCORE criteria.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall verdict confirms the target finding.

reasoning: Uses a different ESS round (Round 5) than the four original rounds, so secondary-data replication with a different sample, rather than re-analysis of the original observations. PDF title, author and target match the assigned SCORE report; the report itself does not list all catalog contributors.
